jojo_ripples.skill.time_stop.desc:
Star Platinum stops the flow of time for a brief moment, allowing only you to act freely while time is frozen.
Hold to charge: let go before half the charge and nothing happens. In an emergency, press twice quickly to stop time at once, for only a moment.
